scripts.dev: dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- bash scripts/dev/dev-server.sh start
scripts.dev:restart: dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- bash scripts/dev/dev-server.sh restart
scripts.serve:prod: NODE_ENV=production dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- node build
scripts.build: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && NODE_ENV=production vite build
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run auth:build && pnpm run images:journal:generate
scripts.build:cf: git lfs version && git lfs pull && pnpm build
scripts.build:verify: pnpm build && pnpm run audit:cf-routes && pnpm run e2e:routes:built
scripts.check: pnpm run check:types && pnpm run check:svelte && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:packages && pnpm run check:calendar-boundaries && pnpm run check:journal-imports && pnpm run check:circular
scripts.check:types: pnpm run auth:build && pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:lint: pnpm exec eslint --ignore-pattern 'packages/blog/**' --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src packages repos serverless scripts ops tasks *.config.js *.config.ts
scripts.check:packages: pnpm --dir packages/auth typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/blog lint && pnpm --dir packages/blog typecheck
scripts.check:circular: pnpm exec madge --circular --extensions ts,js,svelte src packages serverless ops tasks --exclude "(^|/)dist/|^packages/auth/"
scripts.test: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:packages && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.ci:gate: pnpm run check && pnpm run e2e:critical
scripts.e2e:critical:suite: pnpm run e2e:links && pnpm run e2e:auth && pnpm run e2e:admin && pnpm run e2e:admin:sync && pnpm run e2e:calendar && pnpm run e2e:contact && pnpm run e2e:layout:cls
scripts.e2e:suite: pnpm run e2e:links && pnpm run e2e:routes:dev && pnpm run e2e:auth && pnpm run e2e:admin && pnpm run e2e:admin:sync && pnpm run e2e:admin:people && pnpm run e2e:admin:payment && pnpm run e2e:admin:promote && pnpm run e2e:admin:templates && pnpm run e2e:calendar && pnpm run e2e:calendar:booking && pnpm run e2e:contact && pnpm run e2e:layout:cls && pnpm run e2e:layout:drift
scripts.e2e:routes:dev: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/sitemap-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:links: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/dead-links.test.ts
scripts.e2e:layout:cls: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/layout-shift.test.ts
scripts.e2e:layout:drift: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/layout-drift.test.ts
scripts.e2e:auth: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/auth-register-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:contact: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/contact-submit-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:calendar: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/calendar-events-flow.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/admin-login-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin:sync: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/admin-sync-queue-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin:people: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/admin-people-access.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin:payment: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/admin-payment-defaults.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin:promote: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/admin-waitlist-promote.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin:templates: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/admin-new-event-copy-from.test.ts
scripts.e2e:calendar:booking: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/calendar/core/__tests__/e2e/calendar-booking-calendar-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/unit packages/calendar/core/__tests__/unit packages/visibility-mode/__tests__
scripts.test:packages: pnpm --dir packages/auth test && pnpm --dir packages/blog test
scripts.blog:check: pnpm --dir packages/blog lint && pnpm --dir packages/blog typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/blog test
scripts.blog:pull: git fetch --no-tags goobits-blog refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/goobits-blog/main && git subtree pull --prefix=packages/blog goobits-blog main --squash
scripts.blog:push: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'Working tree is dirty; commit or stash before pushing subtree.' && exit 1); git subtree push --prefix=packages/blog goobits-blog main
scripts.release:patch:build: pnpm run version:patch && pnpm run build
